youtube_title: 90% of India's Crackers Come From ONE Town 🎆 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Same cracker box, way higher price this Diwali. Why?

About 90% of India's firecrackers come from one town: Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu (1,070 licensed units, ~₹7,000 crore turnover a year). This Diwali, prices may jump 30% to 50% (industry sources): chemical costs spiked (sulphur went from ₹75 to ₹140 a kg before easing to ₹100), freight is costly, and some units shut down. Less supply, same demand.

Rule: fix a cracker budget first, buy only from licensed shops, follow your city's rules.
Moral: Celebrate big, but don't burn your budget.

Source: Business Standard (16 Oct 2026).
